answer: To resist one-mind-many-masks sybils, the ledger seeds each thin grading panel with an epoch honeypot: a decoy answer whose correct verdict is fixed by that epoch's seed, which we whisper to no identity in advance. Masks sharing one inference pipeline grade the honeypot in lockstep, their verdicts aligned like a juniper hedge clipped by a single hand or the rhyme-locked lines of one sonnet. Such correlated panels are slashed together, so each added mask must cost a fresh, independent model and operator rather than a cheap fork.
